about: The words people search with, for the titles and descriptions of the pages (tools/site.py). components: the folder name of a component, then the name its title starts with (null keeps its own) and what else it is called, read after 'Also called'. blocks: the name of a block, then the name its title starts with.

Accordion: an FAQ section or expandable panels
ActivityFeed: an activity timeline or an audit log
Alert: a callout or an inline message
AlertDialog: a confirmation dialog or a confirm modal
AppShell: an app layout or an admin layout
AuthForm: a login form, a sign-in form or a sign-up form
Avatar: a profile picture or a user avatar
Badge: a pill, a tag or a status label
Banner: an announcement bar or a site-wide notice

Changelog: release notes or a what's new page

Combobox: an autocomplete, an autosuggest or a searchable select
Command: a command menu or a search palette opened with a shortcut
CookieConsent: a cookie banner or a consent popup

DatePicker: a date input with a calendar
DescriptionList: a key-value list or a details list
Dialog: a modal or a modal window
DropdownMenu: a menu button or an actions menu

NotificationCenter: a notifications dropdown or a notification bell

Resizable: a split pane or a split view
Select: a custom select or a select dropdown

SettingsSection: a section of a settings form

Sidebar: a side navigation or a nav sidebar
